name: 陳信安
objective: This course is to introduce elementary topics about Crystallography in materials science.
課程進度(1-16週):
1. Crystal
2. Bravais lattice
3. Diffraction and selection rule
4. Symmetry operation
5. Point group
6. Structure determination
7. Other related topics
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
● 遠距教學 (Distance learning)
